title: Small Group Beach Yoga in San Diego
blurb:
No Yoga Experience? No Problem!

Whether you're new to yoga or an experienced yogi, this session is designed just for you. I will custom-tailor the experience to meet your individual needs and comfort level.

Together, we’ll move through a fun and energetic flow that promotes mental clarity, deepens body awareness, and leaves you feeling calm, centered, and refreshed. Expect a supportive environment, clear guidance, and plenty of options to move at your own pace.

Come as you are — and leave feeling stronger, lighter, and more at peace.

Explore La Jolla, Aka Jewel of the Sea, after your session! 
* Hike the beautiful trails at Torrey Pines State Park
* Paragliding from the Gliderport
* Visit the sea lions at La Jolla Cove
* luxury boutiques, art galleries, and top-tier dining
